items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Yeah, Rabbit, yeah, Rabbit, he was, he wasn't much, but he was used to sing a whole lot, you know. Fake, you know, go around and play around with fish fries, you see.

ctx.x: Did you know Rabbit that played guitar?

Yeah, Rabbit, yeah, Rabbit, he was, he wasn't much, but he was used to sing a whole lot, you know. Fake, you know, go around and play around with fish fries, you see. There's a lot of fish fries. Every Saturday night, you see, you see all around Cypress Street. All them people used to get fish fries and hang a red lamp out on the front. The gateway, a red lamp. That was fish fries. People would go in there and sit down and eat fish and drink beer and stuff, you know. And they had the old drinks, they called it…
What's your grandma called him Rabbit? Yeah.
